name: Zechariah
overview: Zechariah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Jehoshaphat. The biblical record provides limited additional personal details about him beyond this lineage. His role and significance are primarily tied to his family connections as noted in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Zechariah means 'YHWH remembers,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning rooted in God's faithfulness. This proper name is recorded in 2 Chronicles 21:2 and was not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zechariah as the son of Jehoshaphat. Additionally, it is inferred that Zechariah was killed by Jehoram, suggesting a tragic end within his familial context. No other family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zechariah's significance in the biblical narrative is connected to his identity as the son of Jehoshaphat and his death at the hands of Jehoram. These details situate him within the royal history of Judah and highlight the turbulent period recorded in 2 Chronicles 21. His mention underscores God's providential remembrance even amid familial and national conflict.
